description:
The 'InsectSprays.csv' dataset is open in Jamovi. It contains insect counts for 6 different spray types (A-F). Your goal is to compare Spray 'C' against a specific control group, Spray 'F'.

1. First, in the Data tab, modify the 'spray' variable setup to make 'F' the reference level. Reorder the levels so 'F' is first (at the top of the list), followed by the others.
2. Go to Analyses > ANOVA > ANOVA (do NOT use 'One-Way ANOVA', use the general 'ANOVA' module which supports contrasts).
3. Set 'count' as the Dependent Variable and 'spray' as the Fixed Factor.
4. Open the 'Contrasts' section. For the 'spray' factor, select 'Simple' contrasts (this compares each level to the first level, which you set as F).
5. Locate the contrast table in the results. Find the t-statistic for the comparison of C vs F (labeled as 'C – F' or just 'C' in the contrasts table).
6. Save the project as '~/Documents/Jamovi/Spray_Contrasts.omv'.
7. Create a text file '~/Documents/Jamovi/contrast_report.txt' and write ONLY the t-statistic value into it (e.g., -5.123).
